curiosity_trigger: noticing an unusually deep clay planter with a narrow mouth while rearranging pots
reaction: pauses, turns the planter in his hands, and studies its jar-like shape
book_retrieval: sets the planter down, wipes his hands on his overalls, and pulls a worn book from the greenhouse shelf
world_style_hint: Aegean bronze-relief and mineral-pigment story world with sculpted terracotta figures, oxidized copper teal, charcoal black, sun-baked ochre, restrained gold inlay, and dramatic low raking light
reason: Handling ordinary terracotta planters naturally creates the visual question of why Pandora's famous 'box' was originally a large clay storage jar without forcing a mythic artifact into the home world.
